# PadelWrist

> PadelWrist is a padel scoring app for Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad, plus a practical padel knowledge base covering rules, scoring, tactics, technique, equipment and social formats.

Last updated: 2026-08-20.

## Product status

PadelWrist is available on the Apple App Store.

- Official App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/padelwrist/id6799725420
- App Store ID: 6799725420
- Website: https://padelwrist.com/
- Support: https://padelwrist.com/support/
- Privacy: https://padelwrist.com/privacy/

PadelWrist supports standard padel scoring with games, sets and tie-breaks, Fixed Points scoring, server tracking, spoken score announcements, undo and score correction, saved players, match history, historic result editing and resuming unfinished matches. It does not require an account.

Apple Watch is the primary wrist-first scoring surface. iPhone and iPad provide larger-screen setup, scoring and match-management experiences. Active scoring is local-first, so temporary device connection loss does not stop the scoring device. Apple Watch does not communicate directly with iPad through WatchConnectivity; where both participate in the same match, the paired iPhone provides the relay path.

PadelWrist does not currently organise Americano or Mexicano tournaments, rotate partners, generate pairings or standings, provide social networking or cloud accounts, or claim Apple Health and heart-rate features.

## Knowledge base

The main guide index is https://padelwrist.com/guides/. Rules-based articles use the International Padel Federation as the primary official source and show review dates where current rule status matters. Tactical and technique articles explain commonly taught padel principles without presenting coaching advice as official rules. Social formats are described as common formats because organiser rules vary.

Key references:

- https://padelwrist.com/padel-rules/
